name: Getac ZX80-EX
summary: The Getac ZX80-EX is the hazardous-area version of a Getac rugged 8-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under IECEx. Getac also states ATEX certification, but the certificate isn't published. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Android 15.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 0 (2026-01-28), checked 2026-10-25; ATEX not published; UKEX not found

iecex.marking: Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc

certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ic) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: Ambient −21 to +55 °C. Protect from excessive UV light and mechanical impact (reduced-height impact test). Connection interfaces never used in hazardous areas. Battery never changed, charged or removed in hazardous areas. Not next to strong charge-generating processes. Use only battery BP1S1P4060B or BP1S1P4990B.
safety.peripherals: All connection interfaces (USB, Thunderbolt, DC-in, docking connector, LAN, serial) must never be used in hazardous areas (certificate condition). Optional internal modules named in the certificate are covered as part of the certified tablet. USB-C, microSD and SIM tray barred from hazardous areas.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Named in the IECEx certificate: hand strap, shoulder strap, digitizer pen and tether. Anti-static screen film for hazardous use. Rotating hand strap with kickstand and vehicle cradle (datasheet) are not named in the certificate. NOT for hazardous areas: 65 W USB-C adapter, vehicle adapter, chargers, batteries (replace in non-hazardous areas only).

os.name: Android
os.upgradeLimit: At least three Android versions per generation (Getac, device dependent)

specs.display: 8-inch TFT LCD wide viewing angle; Ex model has 0.6 mm thicker glass per ZX80W-EX press release
specs.chip: Qualcomm QCS6490 octa-core 1.9 GHz (max 2.7 GHz), Adreno 643, Hexagon NPU 13 TOPS
specs.battery: Internal typical 4060 (min 3950), 3.86 V; optional second battery 4990 typical
specs.hotSwap: Internal battery plus optional swappable 4990 mAh battery; hot-swap not stated for the Ex datasheet
specs.ports: USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-C (DP, PD), microSD (or hybrid nano-SIM tray + microSD), audio combo; optional 1D/2D barcode imager, NFC; all barred from hazardous areas
specs.network: Wi-Fi 6E; optional 4G LTE, 5G Sub-6, dual SIM with eSIM
specs.gnss: Optional dedicated GPS (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou; US, UK, EU, AU, NZ only)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (16 MP rear, 8 MP front)

unconfirmed.certification.iecex.number: Getac's certificate names the model with a 'c' suffix and doesn't name the generation. We matched it to this generation by its batteries, dust group and ambient range.
unconfirmed.safety.certifiedAccessories: Not checked against the certificate for this exact model.

unconfirmed.os.upgradeLimit: From a single or secondary source; the maker doesn't state it for this model.
unconfirmed.os.securityUntil: Getac's date for the standard model; Getac lists no separate date for the EX version.
unconfirmed.launchYear: Approximate: the maker doesn't publish a launch date. Based on the certificate date or the maker's announcement.

strengths: Among the lightest Zone 2 tablets of its size we list, at 780 g in use
limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
